title: Author and launch a live classroom session
persona: A teacher creating one question, saving it, and opening the live host session.
purpose: Cover the browser authoring seam from demo sign-in through deck editor and live launch.
outcome: A saved deck opens in the live host console with the first question ready to present.
prerequisites: The local demo account alice/demo is enabled.

chapters.title: Sign in to the host workspace
chapters.narration: We sign in as the local demo teacher. This is intentionally a browser action because authentication is the one part of the workflow that cannot be reduced to a session API token.

chapters.title: Create and save a question in deck editor
chapters.narration: The structured authoring surface is the deck editor. We give the deck a concrete title, write the question, provide two options, mark the answer, and save the version to the library.

actions.label: Question
actions.value: Which part of a session should be visible to participants?

chapters.title: Open the first question
chapters.narration: The saved deck is started as a session. We ask the first question, and leave the host looking at the live control surface rather than a static preview.
